literal_meaning: গলায় গলায় (neck to neck or throat to throat)
figurative_meaning_en: Extremely intimate, very closely, profoundly (as in deep affection)
example_sentences_in_bangla: তারা গলায় গলায় বন্ধু, কখনো ছাড়ে না।
example_sentences_in_english: They are neck-to-neck friends and never part ways.
The two brothers share a neck-to-neck bond.
note: The idiom evokes physical closeness to symbolize emotional intimacy in Bengali culture.
